pages.title: Breakthrough Requirements
pages.text: Fill cultivation progress and Qi, then open cultivation stats. Check the method limit, required pills, and displayed success chance before beginning.$(br2)Ordinary failure costs progress and health; Golden Core challenges and lightning have separate consequences.

pages.title: Golden Core and Recovery
pages.text: Golden Core advancement requires its challenge and lightning trial. Death during lightning leaves a cracked core and Half-step Golden Core.$(br2)Retrying needs twice the Late Foundation progress requirement plus the other breakthrough conditions. See $(l:cultivation/core_recovery)Cracked Core and Recovery$(/l).
